criteria.name: adhd_artifacts_committed_before_generator
criteria.description: Before each Generator agent invocation, all pending .adhd/ files (contracts, progress, feedback) are staged and committed with a commit message prefixed by '[adhd]'. The Generator starts with no uncommitted .adhd/ files in the working tree.

criteria.name: adhd_commit_message_format
criteria.description: The commit created for .adhd/ artifacts uses a message starting with '[adhd]' and includes the sprint number (e.g., '[adhd] Sprint 2: artifacts').

criteria.name: clean_working_tree_for_generator
criteria.description: After .adhd/ artifacts are committed and before the Generator session begins, running 'git status --porcelain' on .adhd/ paths returns no output, confirming a clean working tree.

criteria.name: revert_uses_git_reset_hard
criteria.description: The revertToCheckpoint function uses 'git reset --hard <sha>' instead of 'git revert --no-commit'. No calls to 'git revert' remain in the revert/rollback code path.

criteria.name: adhd_files_survive_revert
criteria.description: When revertToCheckpoint resets to a checkpoint SHA, .adhd/ files (progress.json, contracts/, feedback/) that were written after the checkpoint are preserved by stashing before reset and unstashing after. The files exist on disk with their pre-revert contents after the operation completes.

criteria.name: stash_unstash_error_handling
criteria.description: If git stash or unstash fails during revertToCheckpoint, the error is logged with a meaningful message and does not cause an unhandled exception. The revert still completes (reset --hard succeeds) even if stash restoration fails.

criteria.name: documenting_status_type
criteria.description: The HarnessProgress type's status union includes 'documenting' as a valid value alongside existing values like 'running', 'complete', etc. TypeScript compilation succeeds with this addition.

criteria.name: documenting_status_set_before_documenter
criteria.description: Before the Documenter agent is invoked, progress.json is written with status set to 'documenting'. This occurs after all sprints pass and before the Documenter starts its work.

criteria.name: complete_status_after_documenter
criteria.description: After the Documenter agent finishes (or is skipped), progress.json is updated to status 'complete'. The 'documenting' status is a transient state visible only while documentation is in progress.

criteria.name: no_regression_on_existing_revert_callers
criteria.description: All existing call sites that invoke revertToCheckpoint continue to work correctly with the new reset-based implementation. Resume flows that trigger checkpoint revert do not fail or leave the repo in a broken state.

criteria.name: commit_is_noop_when_no_changes
criteria.description: If there are no pending .adhd/ changes when the pre-Generator commit step runs (e.g., files were already committed), no empty commit is created. The harness handles the nothing-to-commit case gracefully.

criteria.name: code_quality_naming_and_structure
criteria.description: New functions for artifact committing and stash-based revert have descriptive names (e.g., commitAdhdArtifacts, stashAdhdFiles, unstashAdhdFiles). No copy-pasted git command sequences; shared git helpers are reused or extracted. Error handling uses try/catch with meaningful logged messages, not swallowed errors.

criteria.name: sdk_separation_respected
criteria.description: New orchestration logic (artifact commit, revert changes, status updates) lives in shared/ with zero SDK imports. Any Claude-specific wiring stays in harness-claude/. The AgentRunners DI boundary is not violated.
